purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.searchHint: Bill no, supplier bill no or supplier
purchases.draftNote: This bill is a draft: stock and the supplier balance change only when it is posted.

form.subtitle: Saved as a draft; post it to receive the stock.
form.findProductHint: Scan a barcode or type a name / SKU — Enter adds
form.noItems: No items yet. Scan a barcode or search above (F2).
form.chargesHint: The bill discount, shipping and other costs are spread over the lines by value into the landed cost.
form.vatRecoverable: VAT is recoverable (VAT-registered business), so it is not part of the landed cost.
form.vatInCost: VAT is not recoverable, so it is included in the landed cost.
form.notDraft: Only draft bills can be edited. Use a purchase return to correct a posted bill.

post.title: Post bill
post.hint: Posting receives the stock at landed cost and adds {{total}} to the supplier's balance. Posted bills cannot be edited.

pay.title: Pay supplier
pay.toBill: The payment is applied to this bill.
pay.fifo: The payment is applied to the oldest bills first; any extra is kept as an advance.

cancelDraft.title: Cancel draft bill
cancelDraft.hint: The draft is kept for the record but can no longer be posted.

voidPayment.title: Void payment
voidPayment.hint: The payment is reversed and the amount is owed to the supplier again.

return.title: Return to supplier

modeHints.reduce_payable: The credit first reduces this bill's due ({{due}}); any rest is kept as an advance with the supplier.
modeHints.refund: The credit first reduces this bill's due ({{due}}); the supplier pays back the rest.

return.noLines: Enter a quantity for at least one item.
return.notReceived: Only posted bills can be returned.

errors.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.wholeNumber: This unit takes whole numbers only.
errors.costInvalid: Enter a cost of 0 or more.
errors.discountTooLarge: The discount is more than the amount.
errors.amountOverDue: The amount is more than the due ({{max}}).
errors.receiveQty: Enter 0 up to what is still to come
errors.expectedBeforeOrder: The expected date is before the order date

purchases.orderedNote: This order is waiting for approval before goods can be received.
purchases.approvedNote: Receive goods as they arrive; each delivery adds its value to the supplier's balance.
purchases.closedNote: Closed short on {{date}}: {{reason}}. The rest will not arrive.

order.hint: Placing the order numbers it and locks its lines. Nothing is owed to the supplier until goods arrive.

cancelOrder.title: Cancel purchase order
cancelOrder.hint: Nothing has arrived yet. The order is kept for the record.

receive.title: Receive goods
receive.hint: Enter what arrived now. Lines left at 0 stay on order.

close.title: Close order short
close.hint: The rest of the order will not arrive and is not owed. Received goods stay.
